tasks.instruction: Crouched low beside a wide tree stump, the blue tiger presses both open palms flat against its bark, elbows bent, weight leaning forward as if about to push it over.
tasks.camera: Low three-quarter front shot, wide angle, framing hands and face
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms flat on bark, fingers splayed and unobstructed, face visible
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在树桩旁双手按树皮准备推动

tasks.instruction: Balanced on one knee atop a boulder, the blue tiger holds a large seashell with both hands, tilting it toward one pointed ear to listen, fingers cupped around the ridged shell.
tasks.camera: Eye-level medium shot from the front-left, shell and both hands centered
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands gripping shell edges fully visible, no fingers behind shell
tasks.intent_zh: 单膝跪石上双手捧海螺侧耳倾听

tasks.instruction: Seated cross-legged on a woven mat, the blue tiger shapes a lump of clay, both palms curved around it, thumbs pressing inward while the remaining fingers spread across the wet surface.
tasks.camera: Top-down 45-degree angle over the shoulder, close on hands and clay
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands and all ten fingers visible around the clay lump
tasks.intent_zh: 盘坐编织垫上双手捏塑陶土

tasks.instruction: Leaning far out from a rope ladder, the blue tiger grips a rung with both hands, fingers wrapped over the wood, one foot hooked on the next rung below, tail counterbalancing behind.
tasks.camera: Side profile wide shot, ladder diagonally across frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands on rung with fingers curling over front edge, clearly visible
tasks.intent_zh: 探身抓绳梯横杆向上攀爬

tasks.instruction: Kneeling at a stream, the blue tiger lifts water in both cupped palms toward its muzzle, fingers pressed together tightly, droplets falling between them, reflection shimmering below.
tasks.camera: Front low shot near water level, hands and face mirrored in stream
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both cupped palms and all fingers above water, unobscured
tasks.intent_zh: 跪溪边双手捧水送向嘴边

tasks.instruction: Spinning a wooden hoop on one raised palm, the blue tiger holds the other hand out flat for balance, eyes tracking the hoop, body twisted in a dynamic half-turn mid-motion.
tasks.camera: Dynamic low-angle front shot, hoop blurred with motion
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both open palms visible, hoop not covering the supporting fingers
tasks.intent_zh: 一手托旋转木环另一手平伸保持平衡

tasks.instruction: Suspended upside down from a thick branch, the blue tiger grips the bark with both hands, fingers dug in, legs tucked, head hanging low with an upside-down grin.
tasks.camera: Low upward shot from directly below, branch horizontal across top
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands wrapped over branch, fingers on top edge visible
tasks.intent_zh: 倒挂树枝双手抓握下方咧嘴

tasks.instruction: Pressing both palms against a tall pane of frosted glass, the blue tiger peers through, fingers spread wide, breath fogging a small circle near its nose.
tasks.camera: Straight-on front shot through glass, hands at chest height
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms flat and fully visible against glass, all fingers distinct
tasks.intent_zh: 双手贴磨砂玻璃向里张望

tasks.instruction: Crouched behind a low garden wall, the blue tiger cups both hands around a tiny songbird, thumbs arched to form a gentle cage, eyes soft and focused downward.
tasks.camera: Close front shot, hands and bird centered, wall in soft foreground
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both cupped hands and fingers visible around the bird, no fingers hidden
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲矮墙后双手捧小鸟注视

tasks.instruction: Reaching up to hang a lantern on a hook, the blue tiger stretches both hands overhead, one palm steadying the lantern base, the other hooking the wire, standing on tiptoe.
tasks.camera: Low front shot looking up, lantern and both hands in frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands elevated and visible around lantern and hook
tasks.intent_zh: 踮脚双手举灯笼挂上钩子

tasks.instruction: Lying on its back beneath a large parchment map, the blue tiger holds the map up with both hands, elbows resting on the floor, eyes scanning the drawn coastline.
tasks.camera: Top-down overhead shot, map spread wide, face peeking below
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands gripping map corners, fingers fully visible against parchment
tasks.intent_zh: 仰躺举着地图双手撑开阅读

tasks.instruction: Bent forward at the waist, the blue tiger pushes both palms against a heavy wooden cart wheel, fingers gripping the spokes, one leg braced back for leverage.
tasks.camera: Side low shot, wheel large in foreground, body angled into push
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands on spokes, all fingers wrapped and visible
tasks.intent_zh: 弯腰双手推木车轮子发力

tasks.instruction: Perched on a narrow ledge, the blue tiger presses both palms to the wall behind for support, leaning back, one knee raised, gazing at a distant skyline.
tasks.camera: Three-quarter rear-side shot, hands visible on wall
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms flat on wall behind, fingers splayed outward
tasks.intent_zh: 坐窄檐上双手撑墙后仰远眺

tasks.instruction: Holding a round hand mirror in one palm, the blue tiger uses the other hand's index finger to trace a line of face paint along its cheek, pointing carefully.
tasks.camera: Close front shot, mirror reflecting eye, both hands framed
tasks.visibility_requirement: Mirror-holding hand and pointing hand both fully visible with fingers
tasks.intent_zh: 一手持镜一手食指画脸纹

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a dock edge, the blue tiger dangles a fishing line, both hands cradling the rod, fingers wrapped around cork handle, eyes fixed on the float.
tasks.camera: Side medium shot, dock boards receding into water
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands on rod handle, all fingers visible around cork
tasks.intent_zh: 坐码头边双手握钓竿看浮漂

tasks.instruction: Tucked into a hollow log, the blue tiger holds a tiny lantern with both hands, palms glowing amber, face lit warmly from below, peering out the opening.
tasks.camera: Inside-out front shot from log mouth, lantern glow on face
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands around lantern base, fingers clearly visible in glow
tasks.intent_zh: 蜷在树洞里双手捧小灯笼

tasks.instruction: Mid-leap between two rocks, the blue tiger spreads both palms forward to catch a thrown rope, fingers reaching, one foot trailing behind, mouth open in effort.
tasks.camera: Side action shot, rope arcing into frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands open toward rope, palms and fingers fully visible
tasks.intent_zh: 跃起双手前伸抓绳

tasks.instruction: Pressing both hands against a large drum skin, the blue tiger kneels and leans in, palms flat, fingers spread, as if feeling the rhythm through its paws.
tasks.camera: High three-quarter front shot, drum surface filling lower frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms flat on drum, all fingers spread and visible
tasks.intent_zh: 跪着双手贴鼓面感受震动

tasks.instruction: Holding a small book open with both hands above its face, the blue tiger lies on a hammock, fingers framing the pages, tail hanging loose below.
tasks.camera: Low angle from below hammock, book and face framed
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands holding book edges, fingers visible against pages
tasks.intent_zh: 吊床仰卧双手举书阅读

tasks.instruction: Reaching into a woven basket, the blue tiger spreads both hands to gather apples, fingers curving around the fruit, elbows lifted, head tilted down toward the basket.
tasks.camera: High front shot looking down into basket
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands in basket with fingers visible around apples
tasks.intent_zh: 双手伸进篮子收拢苹果

tasks.instruction: Threading a needle, the blue tiger holds the needle in one palm and pinches the thread with the other hand's thumb and index finger, eyes squinting in concentration.
tasks.camera: Close front shot, hands centered, needle and thread sharp
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible, needle-holding palm and thread-pinching fingers clear
tasks.intent_zh: 一手持针一手捏线穿针

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a swing, the blue tiger grips both ropes overhead, palms wrapped, legs swinging forward, wind lifting the fur on its arms.
tasks.camera: Front dynamic shot, ropes converging upward
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands gripping ropes, all fingers wrapped and visible
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在秋千上双手抓绳向前荡

tasks.instruction: Crouched in tall grass, the blue tiger parts the blades with both hands, palms pushing outward, face peering through the gap it creates.
tasks.camera: Low front shot at grass height, hands dividing stalks
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands pushing grass aside, palms and fingers visible
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲草丛中双手拨开草叶张望

tasks.instruction: Holding a wooden bowl steady with one palm, the blue tiger stirs with the other hand, fingers wrapped around a spoon handle, steam curling upward past its nose.
tasks.camera: High three-quarter shot over bowl, steam soft in frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Bowl-holding palm and spoon-holding fingers both clearly visible
tasks.intent_zh: 一手扶碗一手握勺搅拌

tasks.instruction: Standing before a tall mirror, the blue tiger presses both palms flat against the glass, fingers meeting its reflection's fingers, expression curious.
tasks.camera: Front shot, mirror reflection doubling the hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Real palms flat on glass with fingers fully visible, reflection secondary
tasks.intent_zh: 站镜前双手贴玻璃与倒影对掌

tasks.instruction: Lying prone on a hillside, the blue tiger props its chin on one palm while the other hand idly traces a spiral in the dirt with one finger.
tasks.camera: Side low shot along the ground, spiral in foreground
tasks.visibility_requirement: Chin-supporting palm and dirt-tracing finger both visible
tasks.intent_zh: 趴山坡一手托腮一手画螺旋

tasks.instruction: Gripping a thick rope with both hands, the blue tiger pulls it taut across its chest, feet braced, muscles tensed, teeth gritted in a tug-of-war stance.
tasks.camera: Front low shot, rope diagonal across torso
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands gripping rope, fingers wrapped over top and visible
tasks.intent_zh: 双手抓绳拉紧身体后仰拔河

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a stone step, the blue tiger cradles a small rabbit in both palms, thumbs gentle along its back, fingers forming a soft basket beneath.
tasks.camera: Close front shot, rabbit and hands centered, soft light
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands cradling rabbit, all fingers visible beneath and around
tasks.intent_zh: 坐石阶双手轻托小兔子

tasks.instruction: Leaning over a balcony rail, the blue tiger lets both hands dangle forward, palms open and relaxed, fingers loosely curled, gazing down at a busy street below.
tasks.camera: High front shot, rail and hands in foreground, street blurred below
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both dangling hands with palms and fingers fully visible over rail
tasks.intent_zh: 靠阳台栏杆双手下垂俯视街道

tasks.instruction: Balancing a stack of flat stones on one upturned palm, the blue tiger steadies the tower with the other hand's fingertips, eyes locked on the wobbling top.
tasks.camera: Eye-level side shot, stone stack vertical, hands framing it
tasks.visibility_requirement: Supporting palm and steadying fingertips both clearly visible
tasks.intent_zh: 一手托石堆另一手尖轻扶保持平衡
